description: Atomic vertical delivery plan for all eight researched public tools. Each slice must finish one browser-observable loop before the next dependent slice starts.

requiredSequence: inspect current files and git diff
write and observe a failing focused test
run production build when route or server code changes
run browser acceptance at desktop and mobile
stop without claiming completion if any exit criterion is unverified

slices.name: Canonical route registry and eight-tool directory
slices.description: Reconcile homepage, directory, navigation, sitemap and redirects so exactly the eight contract tools are discoverable with truthful states.
slices.redTest: A route-registry test proves all eight canonical routes and no retired public promise; a deployed-style browser test initially fails on missing/redirected wholesale, ready-by and purchasing routes.
exitCriteria: Directory contains exactly eight canonical entries
Every entry resolves to a tool or truthful chemistry gate
Navigation/sitemap contain no retired subscription/CRM/social routes
Mobile and desktop route/navigation screenshots inspected

slices.name: Anonymous context continuity proved through batch cost
slices.description: Implement the versioned Recipe/Batch Context, local save/reset, share validation and export using batch cost as the first complete consumer.
slices.redTest: A clean-browser test fails until a cost context can save, reload, share, decode, edit and reset without personal data; corrupt and oversized payload cases are included.
exitCriteria: Versioned context schema and migration boundary exist
Local save state is truthful
Clean-browser share round trip works
Oversized payload offers context download
Corrupt payload fails safely

slices.name: Formulation engine and gated complete tool
slices.description: Deliver the full TOOL-FORM engine, schemas, API, UI, math/provenance view and transfer output while retaining fail-closed public chemistry.
slices.redTest: CALCULATION-SPEC §14 vectors and invariant tests fail first for any missing NaOH/KOH/mixed/purity/superfat/water behavior; browser test initially fails until the complete form and typed gate state exist.
exitCriteria: All normative algebra and invariant vectors pass
No hidden oil mass, property band or oil-level IFRA path remains
API and UI share canonical engine/schema
Complete UI handles all states
Public flag defaults OFF and returns no quantities
Context export is versioned

slices.name: Chemistry source and independent publication gate
slices.description: Collect and validate the external evidence that alone can allow production formulation output; implementation cannot self-approve this slice.
slices.redTest: Gate test proves every unverified/conflicted ingredient remains unavailable and the feature flag alone cannot bypass eligibility.
exitCriteria: Authoritative manifest provenance complete
Conflicts have explicit dispositions
Hand and two specialist comparison records exist
Exact IFRA certificate rule enforced
Named domain and safety review receipts exist
Independent deployed release-enabled verification recorded
verification: independent release-enabled browser check after receipts

slices.name: Mold volume and calibrated capacity tool
slices.description: Complete TOOL-MOLD across engine, API, browser UI, math view, continuity and scaling handoff.
slices.redTest: Golden tests fail for metric/imperial geometry, measured/irregular volume, calibrated mass, uncalibrated range and reverse scaling before implementation.
exitCriteria: All shapes and units work
Calibration is required for precise mass
Planning mode shows range and provenance
Math and output type are visible
Local/share/export and scale handoff work

slices.name: Two-mode recipe scaling tool
slices.description: Complete TOOL-SCALE with proportional-copy and formulation-recalculation modes and explicit chemistry boundary.
slices.redTest: Tests demonstrate that copy mode and chemistry-recalculation mode intentionally differ and that no rounded intermediate is reused.
exitCriteria: Both modes are explicit and correct
Formulation mode uses canonical engine
Invalid/incomplete chemistry is not labelled verified
All target sources and units work
Cost/purchase handoff works

slices.name: Complete batch costing and saleable-yield tool
slices.description: Close route/UI/engine gaps in TOOL-COST after context primitives exist.
slices.redTest: API/UI parity test initially exposes omitted labor, packaging, overhead, exclusions, currency and missing-basis fields; markup/margin fixtures guard labels.
exitCriteria: Complete cost stack is accepted end to end
Missing basis remains named and incomplete
Made and saleable denominators are visible
Markup/margin labels and formulas are correct
No email gate
Wholesale handoff works

slices.name: Wholesale pricing and quote tool
slices.description: Build the missing canonical TOOL-WHOLESALE page and replace route-local markup-only behavior with canonical pricing algebra.
slices.redTest: Reference cases fail until markup, gross margin, percentage/fixed fees, impossible denominator, MOQ and quote output are all represented in API and UI.
exitCriteria: Canonical page returns functional UI
No duplicate pricing formula in route
Both pricing modes and fees are algebraically correct
Incomplete cost cannot become recommendation
MOQ and printable quote work

slices.name: Multi-product craft-fair planning tool
slices.description: Expand TOOL-EVENT from single-item arithmetic to weighted multi-product break-even, target profit, sell-through and stock planning.
slices.redTest: Tests fail for zero fixed costs, multi-product mix, fees, target profit, sell-through, stock limit and non-positive contribution before engine/API/UI completion.
exitCriteria: Zero fixed cost is valid
Weighted contribution and ceilings are inspectable
Stock/sell-through scenario is explicit
Infeasible contribution/stock is handled
Pricing context imports and export works

slices.name: Ready-by production and capacity planner
slices.description: Replace retired production route with canonical TOOL-READY UI, date-only scheduling and capacity conflict behavior.
slices.redTest: Date vectors fail on leap/month/DST-zone cases and capacity/blackout constraints before implementation; route test initially catches redirect.
exitCriteria: Canonical page is functional
Date chain and batches are correct
Blackouts/capacity produce feasible schedule or explicit conflict
No automated cure-safety statement
Purchasing handoff and export work
verification: focused production/API tests under multiple TZ values

slices.name: Ingredient purchase and supplier comparison tool
slices.description: Replace retired purchasing route with canonical TOOL-PURCHASE aggregation, stock, pack and landed-cost workflow.
slices.redTest: Tests fail for multi-batch normalization, reserved stock, exact/partial packs, overbuy, minimum order, landed cost and mixed currency before vertical completion.
exitCriteria: Canonical page is functional
Requirements aggregate before stock subtraction
Pack and overbuy math are visible
Supplier comparison uses landed cost and one currency
No automatic depletion claim
Print/export works

slices.name: Cross-tool context handoff completion
slices.description: Wire and verify every named handoff once all eight tool contracts exist; remove manual re-entry at approved seams.
slices.redTest: A journey suite fails at every missing inherited-field seam and verifies source labels, edits, version mismatch and recalculation.
exitCriteria: All approved handoffs work without manual re-entry
Each destination reviews and edits imported fields
Version mismatches are explicit
No personal data crosses context
Full F-01 through F-09 chain evidence exists

slices.name: Methodology and source documentation
slices.description: Make every equation, unit, assumption, limitation, source and revision inspectable from its tool.
slices.redTest: A registry test fails until every tool/version links to a methodology section with required provenance fields.
exitCriteria: All eight tools have direct methodology links
Equations match canonical engines
Source/revision/conflict status is truthful
No disclaimer masks missing correctness

slices.name: Editable examples and ungated artifacts
slices.description: Provide one independently verified editable example per tool and usable portable templates without capture gates.
slices.redTest: Fixture registry fails until each tool has independently specified inputs/expected output and changing an input updates the live result.
exitCriteria: Eight editable examples are labelled and verified
Templates contain usable content
No login/email gate
Revision compatibility is visible
Desktop/mobile and download checks pass

slices.name: Evidence-graded factual comparisons
slices.description: Reconcile comparison pages to dated observed evidence and remove unverifiable or stale claims.
slices.redTest: Content validation fails when any comparison row lacks observation date, evidence grade, source or current SoapCraft route.
exitCriteria: Every published comparison row is evidence-backed
Stale/unverified claims are removed or unavailable
No invented superiority
Links and metadata match working tool state

slices.name: Independent deployed acceptance
slices.description: Refute completion claims across all capabilities and flows on the deployed commit before changing Gate_A.
slices.redTest: Independent verifier starts from an assumption of failure and records counterexamples for any route, formula, error, handoff, accessibility, deployment or gate mismatch.
exitCriteria: All quality commands succeed on exact deployed commit
All 12 flows pass in real browsers
Desktop/mobile/accessibility/print evidence inspected
Route/sitemap/metadata/security evidence passes
Chemistry remains closed unless receipts pass
Only independent verifier may write RELEASE_ACCEPTED

Gate_C.note: Isaac authorized all eight researched public tools on 2026-09-11.

Gate_R.description: Required planning and implementation skills receipted

Gate_A.description: Independent deployed acceptance; only literal RELEASE_ACCEPTED closes this gate
